summary_1line: Gandhari’s boon leads to the miraculous birth of the Kauravas, with ominous signs at Duryodhana’s birth and ignored advice to abandon him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Gandhari strikes her womb in grief and a hard iron-like ball of flesh falls to the floor before the astonished sage Vyasa.
Vyasa divides the strange mass into many thumb-sized pieces and places them into a hundred pots filled with clarified butter in a hidden chamber.
Newborn Duryodhana cries like a braying ass while jackals, vultures, and crows shriek under dark winds and fires flare ominously around the palace.
